Kitesurf runs browser components in isolated WebAssembly/Rust environments on Cloudflare Workers and supports the Chrome DevTools Protocol, allowing tools such as Playwright and Puppeteer to drive it with lower resource overhead than a full Chromium browser. By Renato Losio
unclustered.headline: Cloudflare Launches Kitesurf: Browser Engine Built for AI Agents
